approval.rationale: All scalar fields from the HuggingFaceAsset contract are mapped: stable identity and descriptive fields (title, url, published_at, country_code, asset_type) belong to the entity, while mutable engagement counters (download_count, follow_count, like_count) belong to the observation. Nested object and array fields (publisher, institution_infos, tags, strategic_tag_ids) are mapped as relations to typed concept nodes (Publisher, Institution, Tag, StrategicTag) with appropriate id and label paths, avoiding opaque JSON strings. Conservative defaults (/name, /id) are used for nested object fields consistent with Hugging Face API conventions; missing nested structures remain unknown.
